create_submission_file_oc20: create an evalAI submission file for OC20 dataset by joining id, ood_ads, ood_cat, and ood_both split results
create_submission_file_oc22: create an evalAI submission file for OC22 dataset by joining id and ood split results
run_is2re_relaxations_from_trajectories: run IS2RE relaxation predictions from ASE trajectory files using the --is2re-relaxations flag
run_is2re_hybrid_predictions: run IS2RE hybrid predictions from S2EF NPZ files using both --is2re-relaxations and --hybrid flags
refactor_write_predictions: refactor the write_predictions function to support additional dataset splits beyond OC20 and OC22
